settings.baseStyle: cozy flat cartoon illustration, children's book style. No harsh outlines, soft edges. Flat shading with one soft shadow layer. Slightly chibi proportions (large head, small body). Children's book illustration aesthetic style.
settings.baseNegative: no harsh outlines, no realistic proportions, no complex shading, no busy background.

scenes.story_en: Last Monday morning, in the narrow hallway by our front door, my son was trying to put on his shoes.

A small child sits on the floor with his shoes beside him, slowly reaching toward them and trying to position one shoe while the soft morning stillness carries a quiet sense of time pressure. SFX: faint hallway rustle, distant morning household sounds.

scenes.story_en: And in that moment, I realized — I wasn’t just putting on his shoe for him. I was taking away one small chance for his brain to grow.

Her fingers stop mid-action, her expression subtly changes from urgency to guilt, and the warm light feels slightly muted as the child remains quiet beneath her gaze.

Steam drifts gently upward from the cup, and the soft paper-like texture subtly breathes with warmth while the frame stays calm and reassuring.

The neural lights pulse faintly, small home objects sit quietly around the child, and the glow suggests growth happening through ordinary daily moments.

scenes.story_en: And then you do it for them. You pull the shirt over their head. You push their arms into the sleeves.
scenes.imagePrompt: Create an illustration on a solid warm cream background. Use a soft 2D essay illustration style with clean flat shapes, minimal cozy character design, subtle paper texture, and simple rounded forms. Keep the composition spacious with plenty of negative space. All objects must be clearly separated from each other. Show a young parent kneeling on the left, gently pulling a small shirt down over a toddler’s head. The toddler stands in the center with arms slightly raised but passive, as if the parent is doing the task for them. The shirt should partly cover the child’s face, clearly showing the action of dressing them. On the far right, place a small clothing pile as a separate object. Keep the silhouettes very clear and readable.

scenes.story_en: You put on the shoes. You wipe their mouth. You clean up the toys. You open the milk carton.
scenes.imagePrompt: Create an illustration on a solid pale beige background. Use a warm 2D essay illustration style with soft flat colors, simple rounded characters, subtle paper texture, and minimal clean shapes. Keep the layout wide and spacious. All objects and action groups must be far apart from one another with clear empty space between them. Show one wide composition divided into four separated action zones from left to right, all within the same image. The theme is a parent doing everything for a toddler. On the far left, show a parent’s hand putting a small shoe onto the child’s foot. In the center-left, show the parent wiping the child’s mouth with a white napkin. In the center-right, show a few simple toys being cleaned up into a small basket. On the far right, show a parent’s hand opening a milk carton. The toddler should appear passive and dependent, sitting or standing calmly, while the parent is busy doing all the tasks. Keep every action zone visually distinct and uncluttered.

scenes.story_en: You do all the things your child “can” do, simply because this morning, you do not have the strength to wait.
scenes.imagePrompt: metaphor visual, parent silhouette surrounded by many floating household tasks like shoes, toys, cup, jacket, all orbiting like a storm, child small and still beneath, muted morning light, emotion of fatigue and compassion
scenes.videoPrompt: A tired parent silhouette stands in muted morning light, surrounded by floating household tasks like shoes, toys, a cup, and a jacket orbiting like a soft domestic storm, while the child sits small and still beneath. The objects drift slowly around the parent, the silhouette subtly sinks with fatigue, and the child remains quiet within the swirl of exhausted love.

scenes.story_en: I am a Japanese mother. I grew up hearing things like, “Children should learn to do their own things.”

A page edge lifts slightly as if touched by memory, dust motes drift through the light, and the still objects carry the feeling of inherited family wisdom. SFX: faint paper rustle.

scenes.story_en: I read Bowlby. I know Vygotsky’s idea of scaffolding — giving just enough support so a child can step to the next level.
scenes.imagePrompt: educational explanatory visualization, painterly diagram of a small child climbing gentle wooden steps with a parent's hand hovering nearby but not pulling, books labeled attachment and scaffolding softly blurred on a desk, calm intellectual mood
scenes.videoPrompt: A calm educational visualization shows a small child climbing gentle wooden steps while a parent's hand hovers nearby without pulling, with books labeled attachment and scaffolding softly blurred on a desk. The child's foot lifts carefully to the next step, the parent's hand remains steady in support, and the warm desk light gives the theory a human, practical feeling.

scenes.story_en: I know many theories.
scenes.imagePrompt: object close-up detail shot, stack of parenting and child development books with sticky notes and a tea cup beside them, warm lamplight, honest humility

scenes.story_en: But last week, I still took the shoe out of my child’s hands.
scenes.imagePrompt: object close-up detail shot, mother's hand gently but quickly removing a small shoe from a child's fingers, hallway floor visible, soft shadows, emotion of regret beginning

scenes.story_en: Not because I do not love him. Because I love him, and because I was tired.
scenes.imagePrompt: character close-up, Naomi's tired face in profile, eyes softened with love and strain, child blurred in foreground, muted warm light, tender melancholy
scenes.videoPrompt: Naomi's tired face is shown in profile, her eyes softened with love and strain while the child remains blurred in the foreground under muted warm light. She breathes quietly, her eyelids lower with exhaustion, and the child shifts faintly out of focus, holding the scene in tender melancholy.

scenes.story_en: And because modern life does not wait for a three-year-old to try fastening the Velcro for the sixth time.
scenes.imagePrompt: scale contrast, tiny child sitting with a shoe strap beneath an oversized looming wall clock and calendar, parent shadow nearby, morning light stretched long, pressure of modern time
scenes.videoPrompt: A tiny child sits with a shoe strap beneath an oversized looming wall clock and calendar, with a parent shadow nearby and long morning light stretching across the floor. The clock hand ticks forward, the child repeatedly works at the Velcro strap, and the parent's shadow stays tense and still beside the pressure of modern time. SFX: soft clock ticking, faint Velcro scratch.

scenes.story_en: Then I saw his face. He did not cry. He did not get angry.
scenes.imagePrompt: character close-up, child's face from shoulders up, eyes lowered, mouth still, no tears, soft hallway background, quiet emotional weight

scenes.story_en: He just became quiet for a moment. That was the part that hurt me most.
scenes.imagePrompt: negative space frame, small child seated low in the corner of a large pale hallway frame, mother partly visible but distant, open empty space around them, muted light, loneliness and hurt
scenes.videoPrompt: A small child sits low in the corner of a large pale hallway frame, surrounded by open empty space, while the mother is partly visible but distant. The child becomes very still, his shoulders barely moving with breath, and the muted light makes the quiet feel heavier than crying.

scenes.story_en: Because sometimes, when we help our children too quickly, the message they receive is not: “Mommy is helping me.”
scenes.imagePrompt: split-screen comparison, left half shows a mother's warm intention as glowing hands helping, right half shows a child's perception as the shoe being taken away, soft painterly contrast, compassionate sadness
scenes.videoPrompt: A soft split-screen contrasts the mother's warm intention, shown as glowing helping hands, with the child's perception, shown as a shoe being taken away. The glow on the mother's side pulses gently with love while the child's side dims slightly, and the shoe shifts from small fingers into adult hands with compassionate sadness.

scenes.story_en: It is: “I am too slow. I cannot do this.”
scenes.imagePrompt: quote text-on-image frame, handwritten text reads “I am too slow. I cannot do this.” over a blurred image of a small shoe on the floor, cool muted beige light, quiet heartbreak

scenes.story_en: In Japanese, there is one word I always return to when I notice myself becoming too rushed.
scenes.imagePrompt: B-roll insert shot, blank washi paper on a wooden desk, brush and ink stone beside it, soft window light, contemplative anticipation

scenes.story_en: That word is Mimamoru — 見守る. Mi means to see. Mamoru means to protect.
scenes.imagePrompt: quote text-on-image frame, large elegant kanji 見守る and roman letters “Mimamoru” on textured washi paper, small annotations “to see” and “to protect,” warm ink wash, reverent reflective mood
scenes.videoPrompt: Large elegant kanji 見守る and the roman letters “Mimamoru” rest on textured washi paper, with small annotations for “to see” and “to protect” in a warm ink wash style. The ink edges subtly bloom into the paper, the annotations appear gently settled around the word, and the quiet frame feels reverent and reflective.

scenes.story_en: Mimamoru means being close enough for the child to feel safe, but far enough to let the child try.
scenes.imagePrompt: wide establishing shot, mother seated on a rug a short distance from a child working with blocks, child centered in foreground, mother calm in background, warm afternoon home light, safe independence
scenes.videoPrompt: A mother sits calmly on a rug a short distance from a child working with blocks, the child centered in the foreground while warm afternoon home light fills the room. The child carefully stacks and adjusts blocks, the mother watches without reaching in, and the space between them feels protective rather than distant. SFX: soft wooden block taps.

scenes.story_en: It is a very difficult kind of love.
scenes.imagePrompt: metaphor visual, two gentle hands forming a loose protective circle around a small sprouting plant without touching it, soft golden light, emotion of restraint and devotion

scenes.story_en: But Mimamoru says: “Wait one more breath.”

scenes.story_en: Not forever. Not until the child is overwhelmed. Just long enough for the child’s brain to have a chance to work.

scenes.videoPrompt: A gentle educational diagram shows a child's brain glowing with small pathways while a parent waits nearby, with a tiny clock icon suggesting a brief pause on a warm neutral background.
